codeReview.summary: The feature was a pure audit of visibility modifiers in katla_app/src/components/. The worker correctly determined that all 20 component types across camera, physics, rendering, scene, and transform modules are already pub. Zero pub(crate) items were found. Zero code changes were needed. The worker verified all 8 systems files successfully import their needed components from crate::components::. All validators passed (cargo check, cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt). The commitId references the HEAD at time of audit (71b98b6), which is the previous feature's commit — no new commit was created since no changes were required.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker spent time investigating whether crate::components::lighting::{DirectionalLight, PointLight} was a valid module path in prelude.rs (it is — via pub mod lighting in rendering/mod.rs re-exported through pub use crate::components::rendering::*). This module re-export chain is not documented in architecture.md. While it works, the path resolution is non-obvious and could trip up future workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows ~8 tool calls investigating the path resolution of crate::components::lighting vs crate::components::rendering::lighting. The rendering/mod.rs has both `pub mod lighting;` and `pub use lighting::*;`, and components/mod.rs has `pub use crate::components::rendering::*;` which transitively re-exports the module path.
